versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support error notification for transformed data communication 43 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 212: AUTOSAR_RS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Requirements on Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The Software Component Template shall provide means to configure the error notification of data transformation. Rationale: SWCs might want to react on transformation errors. Use Case: Safety related SWCs react on errors during safety-checks in the transformation. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
